proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal to Improve Executive Compensation Program
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the company to improve its executive compensation program to include the CEO pay ratio factor.
proposals.evidence: We recommend that you vote against the three stockholder proposals.

proposals.title: Report on Respecting Workforce Civil Liberties
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating how company policies impact employees based on race, religion, sex, national origin or political views, and related business risks.
proposals.evidence: For these reasons, we recommend a vote against the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Racial and Gender Pay Gaps
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including associated risks, and risks related to recruiting and retaining diverse talent.
proposals.evidence: For these reasons, we recommend a vote against the stockholder proposal.
